G2200.def:
ζεστός, -ή, -όν
(ζέω) [in Aq.: Lévitique 6:21; in Al.: Lévitique 7:12 * ;] 
boiling hot (Strab., al.): metaphorically, Apocalypse 3:15-16.†

G2201.def:
ζεῦγος, -εος (-ους), τό
(ζεύγνυμι, to yoke), [in LXX chiefly for צֶמֶד, Juges 19:3, al. ;] 
__1. a yoke of beasts: Luc 14:19. 
__2. a pair of any­thing, Luc 2:24 (LXX).†

G2202.def:
ζευκτήριος, -α -ον
(ζεύγνυμι), 
fit for joining. As subst., 
__(a) ζευκτήριον, τό = ζυγόν, a yoke; 
__(b) ζευκτηρία, -ας, ἡ = ζεύγλη, the crossbar of a double rudder: Actes 27:40 (found nowhere else).†

G2203.def:
Ζεύς 
genitive, Διός, dative, Διΐ, accusative, Δία (Δίαν, D, al.), 
Zeus (Lat. Jupiter): Actes 14:12-13.†

G2204.def:
ζέω 
[in LXX for רוּם, רָתַח, metaphorically, 4Ma.18:20 ;] 
to boil, be hot; metaphorically, of anger, love, zeal: ptcp., fervent: τ. πνεύματι, Actes 18:25, Romains 12:11.†

G2205.def:
ζῆλος, -ου, ὁ and in late Gk., also -εος, τό (2 Corinthiens 9:2, Philippiens 3:6), 
[in LXX for קִנְאָה, Nombres 25:11, al. ;] 
__1. zeal: 2 Corinthiens 7:11 9:2; κατά ζῆλος, Philippiens 3:6; with genitive obj., Jean 2:17 (LXX), Romains 10:2; before ὑπέρ, 2 Corinthiens 7:7; with genitive subj., θεοῦ, 2 Corinthiens 11:2; πυρός, Hébreux 10:27 (cf. Ésaïe 26:11, Wis.5:18, and cf. Westc., in l). 
__2. jealousy: Romains 13:13, 1 Corinthiens 3:3 3:2 2 Corinthiens 12:20, Galates 5:20 (WH, txt, RV), Jacques 3:14, 16; πλησθῆναι ζήλου Actes 5:17 13:45; pl., ζῆλοι (see B1., § 32, 6), Galates 5:20, WH, mg.†

G2206.def:
ζηλόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for קָנָא pi. ;] 
__1. to burn with envy or jealousy, to be jealousy: absol., Actes 7:9 17:5, 1 Corinthiens 13:4, Jacques 4:2 (R, mg., cf. Mayor, in l). 
__2. to seek or desire eagerly: with accusative of thing(s), 1 Corinthiens 12:31 14:1 14:39 (cf. Sir.50:18, Wis.1:12); with accusative of person(s), 2 Corinthiens 11:2, Galates 4:17; pass., Galates 4:18.†

G2207.def:
ζηλωτής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ζηλόω), [in LXX for קַנָּא (θεὸς ζ.), Exode 20:5 34:14, Deutéronome 4:24 5:9 6:15; קַנּוֹא, Nahum 1:2 (θεός); pl., I Esther 8:72; ζ. τῶν νόμων, 2Ma.4:2;τὸν ζ. Φινεές, 4Ma.18:12 (cf. Nombres 25:11)* ;] 
__1. in cl. an emulator, zealous admirer (Plat., al.). 
__2. eagerly desirous, zealous; 
__(a) absol., as in OT, ll. with; 
__(b) with genitive obj.: (zealous to acquire or to defend), 1 Corinthiens 14:12, Tite 2:14, 1 Pierre 3:13; τ. νόμου (2Mac, l.with), Actes 21:20; παραδόσεων, Galates 1:14; with genitive of person(s), θεοῦ, Actes 22:3. 
__3. In FlJ, NT, a Zealot, member of the Jewish party so called: as surname of the Apostle Simon, Luc 6:15, Actes 1:13.†

G2208.def:
Ζηλωτής
In FlJ, NT, 
a Zealot, member of the Jewish party so called: as surname of the Apostle Simon, Luc 6:15, Actes 1:13.†

G2209.def:
ζημία, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX for עָנַשׁ; עֹנֶשׁ ni. and cognate forms ;] 
damage, loss: Actes 27:10, 21 Philippiens 3:8; opposite to κέρδος, Philippiens 3:7.†

G2210.def:
ζημόω, -ῶ
(ζημία), [in LXX chiefly for עָנַשׁ ;] 
to damage. Pass., to suffer loss, forfeit, lose: absol., 1 Corinthiens 3:15; before ἐν, 2 Corinthiens 7:9; with accusative of thing(s) (see B1., § 34, 6), τ. ψυχήν, Matthieu 16:26, Marc 8:36; ἑαυτόν, Luc 9:25; τ. πάντα, Philippiens 3:8.†

G2211.def:
Ζηνᾶς, -ᾶ, accusative -ᾶν
(contr. from Ζηνόδωρος), 
Zenas: Tite 3:13.†

G2212.def:
ζητέω, -ῶ, 
[in LXX chiefly for בּקשׁ pi., also for דּרשׁ, etc. ;] 
__1. to seek, seek for: Matthieu 7:7, 8 Luc 11:9, 10; with accusative of person(s), Marc 1:37, Luc 2:48, Jean 6:24, al.; id. before ἐν, Actes 9:11; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 13:45, Luc 19:10; before ἐν, Luc 13:6, 7; ψυχήν, of plotting against one's life ( Exode 4:19, al.), Matthieu 2:20, Romains 11:3" (LXX) . Metaphorical, to seek by thinking, search after, inquire into: Marc 11:18, Luc 12:28, Jean 16:19; τ. θεόν, Actes 17:27. 
__2. to seek or strive after, desire: Matthieu 12:46, Marc 12:12, Luc 9:9, Jean 5:18, Romains 10:3, al.; τ. θάνατον, Apocalypse 9:6; τ. βασιλείαν τ. θεοῦ, Matthieu 6:33 (Dalman, Words, 121f.); τὰ ἄνω, Colossiens 3:1; εἰρήνην, 1 Pierre 3:11 (LXX). 
__3. to require, demand: with accusative of thing(s), Marc 8:12, Luc 11:29, 1 Corinthiens 1:22, 2 Corinthiens 13:3; before παρά, Marc 8:11, al.; ἵνα, 1 Corinthiens 4:2 (cf. ἀνα-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, συν-ζητέω).

G2213.def:
ζήτημα, -τος, τό
(ζητέω), [in LXX: ζ. τίθεσθαι (דָּרַשׁ ni.), Eze.36:37 A * ;] 
an inquiry, question: Actes 15:2 18:15 23:29 25:19 26:3.†

G2214.def:
ζήτησις, -εως, ἡ
(ζητέω). 
__1. a seeking, search. 
__2. a questioning, inquiry, debate: Actes 15:2, 7, 2 Timothée 2:23, Tite 3:9; before περί, Jean 3:26, Actes 25:20, 1 Timothée 6:4.†

G2215.def:
ζιζάνιον, -ου, τό
(in Talmud זוּנִין), 
zizanium (EV, tares), a kind of darnel, resembling wheat: Matthieu 13:25-40 (cf. DB, see word "Tares").†

G2216G.def:
Ζοροβάβελ (FlJ, Ζοροβάβηλος, -ου), ὁ indecl. (Heb. זְרֻבָּבֶל), 
Zerubbabel (1 Chroniques 3:19, al.): Matthieu 1:12-13 Luc 3:27.†

G2216H.def:
Ζοροβάβελ (FlJ, Ζοροβάβηλος, -ου), ὁ indecl. (Heb. זְרֻבָּבֶל), 
Zerubbabel (1 Chroniques 3:19, al.): Matthieu 1:12-13 Luc 3:27.†

G2217.def:
ζόφος, -ου, ὁ
(akin to γνόφος, which see), [in Sm.: Exode 10:22, Job 28:3, Psaumes 11:2 91:6, Ésaïe 59:9 * ;] 
in Hom, the gloom of the under-world; hence, darkness, deep gloom (poët. and late prose writers): Hébreux 12:18, 2 Pierre 2:4 2:17, Ju 6 13.†
ὁμίχλη, -ης, ἡ, 
[in LXX for עֲרָפֶל, etc. ;] 
a mist: 2 Pierre 2:17 
SYN.: νέφος, νεφέλη, both thicker than ὁ

G2218.def:
ζυγός (in cl. more frequently τὸ ζυγόν), -οῦ, ὁ 
(ζεύγνυμι), [in LXX for עֹל, מֹאזֵן, etc. ;] 
__1. a yoke; metaphorically, of bondage or submission to authority: Matthieu 11:29-30, Actes 15:10, Galates 5:1, 1 Timothée 6:1. 
__2. a balance: Apocalypse 6:5 (of. Ésaïe 40:12, al.).†

G2219.def:
ζύμη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX for חָמֵץ, Exode 12:16 13:3 23:18 34:25, Deutéronome 16:3; שְׂאֹר, Exode 12:16, 19 13:7, Lévitique 2:11, Deutéronome 16:4 * ;] 
leaven: Matthieu 13:33, Luc 13:21; τ. ἄρτου, Matthieu 16:12. Metaphorical, of a moral influence or tendency, always, exc. in the Parable of the Leaven (Matthieu 13:33, Luc 13:21), for evil: 1 Corinthiens 5:6-8, Galates 5:9; ζ. τ. Φαρισαίων, Matthieu 16:6, 11, Marc 8:16, Luc 12:1 (Cremer, 723).†

G2220.def:
ζυμόω, -ῶ
(ζύμη), [in LXX for חָמֵץ, Exode 12:34, 39 Lévitique 6:17 23:17, Osée 7:4 * ;] 
to leaven: Matthieu 13:33, Luc 13:21, 1 Corinthiens 5:6, Galates 5:9.†

G2221.def:
ζωγρέω, -ῶ
(ζωός, alive, + ἀγρεύω) [in LXX chiefly for חָיָה hi. ;] 
to catch alive, take captive: metaphorically, Luc 5:10; pass., 2 Timothée 2:26 (on the meaning and construction, see Ellic., CGT, in l).†

G2222.def:
ζωή, -ῆς, ἡ (ζάω), 
[in LXX chiefly for חַיִּים ;] 
life (in Hom., Hdt., = βίος, which see; later, existence, vita quâ vivimus, as distinct from βίος, vita quam vivimus; opposite to θάνατος); 
__1. of natural life: Luc 16:25, Actes 8:33, 1 Corinthiens 15:19, 1 Timothée 4:8, Hébreux 7:3, Jacques 4:14; πνεῦμα ζωῆς, Apocalypse 11:11; ψυχὴ ζωῆς ( Genèse 1:30), Apocalypse 16:3; of the life of one risen from the dead, Romains 5:10, Hébreux 7:16. 
__2. Of the life of the kingdom of God, the present life of grace and the life of glory which is to follow (Dalman, Words, 156ff.; Westc, Epp. Jo., 214ff.; Cremer, 272ff.): Jean 6:51, 53 Romains 7:10 8:6, 10 Philippiens 2:16, Colossiens 3:4, 2 Pierre 1:3; αἰώνος (reff. supr.; DCG, i, 538a, ii, 30f.), Jean 4:36 12:50 17:3, 1 Jean 1:2, al.; τ. φῶς τῆς ζ., Jean 8:12; ὁ Λόγος τ. ζ., 1 Jean 1:1; ὁ ἄρτος τ. ζ., Jo 6:35, 48; δικαίωσις ζωῆς, Romains 5:18; μετάνοια εἰς ζ., Actes 11:18; ἐν αὐτῷ ζ. ἦν, Jean 1:4; ζ. ἡ ἐν. Χ. Ἰ., 2 Timothée 1:1; τὰ πρὸς ζωήν, 2 Pierre 1:3, al.; στέφανος τῆς ζ., Jacques 1:12, Apocalypse 2:10; χάρις ζωῆς (genitive expl.), 1 Pierre 3:7; ζ. καὶ εἰρήνη, Romains 8:6; ζ. καὶ ἀφθαρσία, 2 Timothée 1:10; ἀνάστασις ζωῆς, Jean 5:29; βίβλος ζωῆς, Philippiens 4:3, Apocalypse 3:5; ξύλον ζωῆς, Apocalypse 2:7; ὕδωρ ζωῆς, Apocalypse 22:17; meton., of that which has life: τ. πνεῦμα, Romains 8:10; ῥήματα, Jean 6:63; of one who gives life, Jean 11:25 14:6, 1 Jean 1:2; ἡ ἐντολή, Jean 12:50. 
SYN.: see: βίος.

G2223.def:
ζώνη, -ης, ἡ
(ζώννυμι) [in LXX for אַבְנֵט, חֲגוֹר, etc. ;] 
a belt, girdle: Matthieu 3:4, Marc 1:6, Actes 21:11, Apocalypse 1:13 15:6; as a receptacle for money, Matthieu 10:9, Marc 6:8.†

G2224.def:
ζώννυμι and ζωννύω 
[in LXX chiefly for חָגַר ;] 
to gird: with accusative of person(s), Jean 21:18. Mid., to gird oneself: Actes 12:8 (cf. ἀνα-, δια-, περι-, ὑπο-ζώννυμι).†

G2225.def:
ζωογονέω, -ῶ
(ζωός, alive, γένεσθαι), [in LXX Exode 1:17-18, 22, Juges 8:19, 1 Rois 2:6 27:9 27:11, 3Ki.20:31, 4Ki.7:4 (חָיָה pi., hi.), Lévitique 11:47 (חַי)* ;] 
__1. in cl., to engender, produce alive, endue with life. 
__2. In LXX. and NT, to preserve alive (DCG, ii, 606; Cremer, 274): Luc 17:33, Actes 7:19, 1 Timothée 6:13 (EV, quickeneth; R, mg., preserveth).†

G2226.def:
ζῷον (Rec. ζῶον, see LS, see word), -ου, τό 
(ζωός, alive), [in LXX for חַי (chiefly) and cognate forms; frequently in Wis ;] 
a living creature, an animal: Apocalypse 4:6-9 5:6 ff. Apocalypse 6:1 ff. Apocalypse 7:11 14:3 15:7 19:4; ζῴων τ. αἷμα, Hébreux 13:11; ἄλογα ζ., 2 Pierre 2:12, Ju 10.†
SYN.: θηρίον, in which the brutal, bestial element is emphasized, and which is never used of sacrificial animals. On the other hand, ζ. is the more comprehensive, as expressing the vital element common to the whole anima] creation (see Tr., Syn., LXXxi; Cremer, 274).

G2227.def:
ζωο-ποιέω, ῶ
[in LXX for חָיָה pi., hi., Juges 21:14, 4Ki.5:7, Néhémie 9:6, Job 36:6, Psaumes 70:20, Ecclésiaste 7:12 * ;] 
__1. in cl. (= ζωογονέω), to produce alive. 
__2. In LXX and NT, to make alive, cause to live, quicken (DCG, ii, 606a; Cremer, 275): Jean 5:21 6:53, Romains 4:17 8:11, 1 Corinthiens 15:45, 2 Corinthiens 3:6, Galates 3:21. Pass., 1 Corinthiens 15:22 15:36, 1 Pierre 3:18.†

G2230.def:
ἡγεμονεύω 
(ἡγεμών), 
__1. to lead the way. 
__2. to lead in war, command (of. Ramsay, Was Christ born at Bethlehem?; DCG, ii, 463 f.). 
__3. to be governor of a province: with genitive loc., Luc 2:2 3:1.†

G2231.def:
ἡγεμονία, -ας, ἡ
(ἡγεμών), [in LXX: Genèse 36:30 (אַלּוּף), Nombres 1:52 2:17, (דֶּגֶל), Sir.7:4 10:1, 4Ma.6:33 4Mac 13:4 * ;] 
rule, sovereignty: Luc 3:1.†

G2232.def:
ἡγεμών, -όνος, ὁ
(ἡγέομαι) [in LXX for אַלּוּף, שַׂר, etc. ;] 
__1. a leader, guide. 
__2. a commander. 
__3. a governor of a province (pro­consul, proprietor, legate, or procurator; but cf. ἀνθύπατος): Matthieu 10:18, Marc 13:9, Luc 21:12, 1 Pierre 2:14; of the Procurator of Judæa, Matthieu 27:2, 11 27:14-15, 21 27:27 28:14, Luc 20:20, Actes 23:24, 26 23:33 24:1, 10 26:30. 
__4. For Heb. אַלְפֵי (LXX, χίλιαι) misread אַלֻּפֵי, leaders: Matthieu 2:6 (OT).†

G2233.def:
ἡγέομαι, -οῦμαι depon. mid., 
[in LXX (chiefly Pres. ptcp.) for נָגִיד, רֹאשׁ, שַׂר, etc. ;] 
__1. to lead; 
__(a) to guide, go before; 
__(b) to rule, be leader: present ptcp., ἡγούενος, a ruler, leader (MM, Exp., xiv), Matthieu 2:6 (LXX), Luc 22:26, Actes 7:10 14:12 15:22, Hébreux 13:7, 17 13:24. 
__2. to suppose, believe, consider, think (Hdt., Soph., al.; of. Lat. duco): with dupl. accusative, Actes 26:2, Philippiens 2:3, 6 3:7, 1 Timothée 1:12 6:1, Hébreux 10:29 11:11, 26, 2 Pierre 1:13 2:13 3:9 3:15; with accusative before ὡς, with accusative, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:15; with accusative before adv., 1 Thessaloniciens 5:13; ὅταν, Jacques 1:2; ἀναγκαῖον, with inf., 2 Corinthiens 9:5, Philippiens 2:25; δίκαιον, with inf., 2 Pierre 1:13; with accusative and inf., Philippiens 3:8 (of. δι-, ἐκ-δι-, ἐξ- προ-ηγέομαι).†
SYN.: see: δοκέω

G2234.def:
ἡδέως 
adv. (ἡδύς, sweet), [in LXX: Proverbes 3:24 (עָרַב), etc. ;] 
gladly, with pleasure: Marc 6:20 12:37, 2 Corinthiens 11:19; superlat., ἥδιστα, very gladly (B1., § 11, 3), 2 Corinthiens 12:9 12:15.†

G2235.def:
ἤδη 
adv., 
in NT, always of time; now, already: Matthieu 3:10, Marc 4:37, Luc 7:6, Jean 4:36, al.; νῦν . . . ἤ., now already, 1 Jean 4:3; ἤ. ποτέ, now at length, with fut., Romains 1:10 (cf. ἄρτι)

G2236.def:
ἥδιστα, see: ἡδέως.
ἡδέως 
adv. (ἡδύς, sweet), [in LXX: Proverbes 3:24 (עָרַב), etc. ;] 
gladly, with pleasure: Marc 6:20 12:37, 2 Corinthiens 11:19; superlat., ἥδιστα, very gladly (B1., § 11, 3), 2 Corinthiens 12:9 12:15.†

G2237.def:
ἡδονή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἥδομαι, to be glad) [in LXX: Nombres 11:8 (טַעַם), Proverbes 17:1, Wis.7:2 16:20, and frequently in 4Mac ;] 
pleasure: 2 Pierre 2:13; pl., Luc 8:14, Tite 3:3, Jacques 4:1, †

G2238.def:
ἡδύ-οσμος, -ον
(ἡδύς, ὀσμή) 
sweet-smelling; as subst., τὸ ἡ., mint: Matthieu 23:23, Luc 11:42.†

G2239.def:
ἦθος, -εος (-ους), τό 
[in LXX: Sir.20:26, 4Ma.1:29 4Mac 2:7 4Mac 2:21 4Mac 5:24 4Mac 13:27 * ;] 
__1 1, a haunt, abode. 
__2. = ἔθος, custom, manner: pl., 1 Corinthiens 15:33.†

G2240.def:
ἥκω 
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;] 
pf. with present meaning (hence imperfect = plpf.), to have come, be present: Matthieu 24:50, Marc 8:3 (late pf., ἧκα, see Swete, in l; WH, App., 169), Luc 12:46 15:27, Jean 8:42, Hébreux 10:7, 9 10:37, I Jn 5:20, Apocalypse 2:25 3:3, 9 15:4; before ἀπό, with genitive loc., Matthieu 8:11, Luc 13:29; ἐκ, Romains 11:26; id. before εἰς, Jean 4:47; μακρόθεν, Marc 8:3; ἐπί, with accusative, Apocalypse 3:3. Metaphorical, of discipleship: Jean 6:37; of time and events: absol., Matthieu 24:14, Jean 2:4, 2 Pierre 3:10, Apocalypse 18:8; before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 23:36, Luc 19:43 (cf. ἀν-, καθ-ήκω).†

G2241.def:
ἡλεί (Rec. ἠλί L, ἠλί; Heb. אֵל), 
Eli, my God: Matthieu 27:46 (cf. ἐλωΐ).†

G2242.def:
Ἡλεί (Rec. Ἡλί; RV, Ἡλί), ὁ, indecl., 
Heli, Joseph's father: Luc 3:23.†

G2243.def:
Ἡλείας (Rec. Ἡλίας; L Tr., Ἡίας; T, Ἡλείας; cf. WH, App., 155, Intr., § 408), -ου (-α, Luc 1:17, WH), ὁ (Heb. אֵלִיָּה,), 
Elijah (3Ki.17:1-24, al.): Matthieu 11:14 16:14 17:3-4, 10-12 27:47, 49, Marc 6:15 8:28 9:4-5, 11-13 15:35-36 Luc 1:17 4:25-26 9:8, 19 9:30, 33 9:54, Jean 1:21, 25, Jacques 5:17; ἐν Ἠ., in the portion concerning E., Romains 11:2.†

G2245.def:
ἡλίκος, -η, -ον 
__1. prop., as big as, as old as. 
__2. As indirect interrog., what sized, what, how great, how small (the sense to be determined by the context): Colossiens 2:1, Jacques 3:5, Galates 6:11 (WH, mg.; πηλ-, WH, txt., RV).†

G2246.def:
ἥλιος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for שֶׁמֶשׁ ;] 
the sun: with art. (El., § 46, 5), Matthieu 5:45 13:43 17:2 24:29, Marc 1:32 4:6 13:24 16:2, Luc 4:40, Actes 2:20" (LXX) Actes 26:13, Éphésiens 4:26, Jacques 1:11, Apocalypse 1:16 6:12 8:12 9:2 10:1 12:1 16:8 19:17 21:23; βλέπειν τὸν ἥ., Actes 13:11; οὐδὲ μὴ πέσῃ ἐπ᾽ αὐτοὺς ὁ ἥ., Apocalypse 7:16; without art., Matthieu 13:6, Luc 21:25 23:45, Actes 27:20, 1 Corinthiens 15:41, Apocalypse 7:2 16:12 22:5.†

G2247.def:
ἧλος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 41:7 מַסְמֵר etc. ;] 
a nail: Jean 20:25.†

G2250.def:
ἡμέρα, -ας, ἡ, 
[in LXX chiefly (very freq.) for יוֹם ;] 
day; 
__1. as distinct from night: genitive ἡμέρας, by day (WM, §30, 11), Apocalypse 21:25; ἡ. κ. νυκτός (ν. κ. ̔ἡ.), Actes 9:24, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:9, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:8, Apocalypse 4:8 (BL, §36, 13); ἡμέρας μέσης, at mid-day, Actes 26:13; accusative durat., τ. ἡμέρας, Luc 21:37; ὅλην τὴν ἡ., Romains 8:36; ἐν ἡμέρα, Jean 11:9, Romains 13:13; ἡμέρας ὁδός, a day's journey, Luc 2:44; ἡ. γίνεται, Lk 4:42 22:66; κλίνει, Luc 9:12, al.; metaphorically, Jean 9:4, Romains 13:12, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:4, 5 8, 2 Pierre 1:19. 
__2. Of a civil day of 24 hours, incl. night: Matthieu 6:34, Marc 6:21, Luc 13:14, al.; τρίτῃ ἡ., Matthieu 16:21; ἡμέρᾳ κ. ἡ. (cf. יוֹם בְּיוֹם, Esther 3:4), 2 Corinthiens 4:16; ὅλην τ. ἡ., Romains 8:36 10:21; pl., Jean 2:12, Actes 9:19, al.; ἡ. τῶν ἀζύμων, Actes 12:3; τ. σαββάτου, Luc 13:14, 16; ἡ κυριάκη ἡ., Apocalypse 1:10. 
__3. In Messianic sense, of the last day: ἡ ἡ. (ἐκείνη, τ. κυρίου, etc.), Matthieu 7:22, Luc 6:23, Romains 13:12, 1 Corinthiens 1:8, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:2, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:2, 2 Pierre 3:10, al; by meton., as compared with the divine judgment on that day, ἡ. ἀνθρωπίνη, of a human tribunal, 1 Corinthiens 4:3 (EV, man's judgment). 
__4. As in Heb. (also in Gk. writers; Bl, §46, 9; M, Pr., 81), of time in general: Jean 8:56 14:20, 2 Corinthiens 6:2, Éphésiens 6:13, 2 Pierre 3:18; pl. Actes 15:7, Éphésiens 5:16, Hébreux 10:32; πᾶσας τὰς ἡ. (cf. כָּל הַיָּמִים, Deutéronome 4:40, al.; MM, Exp., xv), Matthieu 28:20; ἐλεύσονται ἡ. ὅταν (ὅτε), Matthieu 9:15, Marc 2:20, Luc 5:35 17:22; αἱ ἡ., with genitive of person(s) (Genèse 26:1, al.), Matthieu 2:1, Luc 1:5, Actes 7:45, 1 Pierre 3:20; ἀρχ̀ ἡμερῶν, Hébreux 7:3.

G2253.def:
ἡμιθανής, -ές
(ἥμι, half + θνήσκω) [in LXX: 4Ma.4:11 * ;] 
half-dead: Luc 10:30.†

G2255.def:
ἥμισυς, -εια, -υ genitive, -ους (late, as in π., for cl., -εος Bl., § 8, 4; Mayser, 294), n. p1., ἡμίσια (Rec., cl., -εια), 
[in LXX for חֵצִי, מַחֲצִית ;] half; 
__1. as adj., agreeing in gender and number with the substantive following, τὰ ἡμίσια τ. ὑταρχόντων, Luc 19:8. 
__2. As neut. subst., τὸ ἥμισυ, the half; ἥ. (anarth.), a half: with genitive, ἥ. καιροῦ, Apocalypse 12:14; ἕως ἡμίσους τ. βασιλείας μου, Marc 6:23; after a cardinal number, ἡμέρας τρεῖς κ. ἥμισυ, Apocalypse 11:9, 11.†

G2256.def:
ἡμίωρον (Rec. -ιον), -ου, τό 
(ἥμι, half + ὥρα), 
half an hour: Apocalypse 8:1.†

G2259.def:
ἡνίκα 
rel. adv. of time, 
at which time, when; before αν, with subjc., whensoever: 2 Corinthiens 3:15-16.†

G2261.def:
ἤπιος, -α, -ον 
mild, gentle: 1 Thessaloniciens 2:7 (WH, R, mg., νήπιος); before πρός, 2 Timothée 2:24.†

G2262.def:
Ἤρ (L, Ἥρ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. עֵר), 
Er, an ancestor of Jesus: Luc 3:28.†

G2263.def:
ἤρεμος-ον 
[in LXX Esther 3:13 A* ;] 
quiet, tranquil (Luc., al.): 1 Timothée 2:2.†
SYN: ἡσύχιος, q.v

G2264G.def:
Ἡρῴδης (Rec. -ώδης), -ου, ὁ 
Herod; 
__1. Herod the Great: Matthieu 2:1-23, Actes 23:35. 
__2. Herod Antipas (ὁ τετραάρχης, Matthieu 14:1): Matthieu 14:1, 3 14:6, Marc 6:1-56, Marc 8:15, Luc 1:5 3:1, 19 8:3 9:7, 9 13:31, 23, Actes 4:27 13:1. 
__3. Herod Agrippa I: Actes 12:1, 6 12:11, 19 12:21 (cf. Ἀγρίππας (II)).†

G2264H.def:
Ἡρῴδης (Rec. -ώδης), -ου, ὁ 
Herod; 
__1. Herod the Great: Matthieu 2:1-23, Actes 23:35. 
__2. Herod Antipas (ὁ τετραάρχης, Matthieu 14:1): Matthieu 14:1, 3 14:6, Marc 6:1-56, Marc 8:15, Luc 1:5 3:1, 19 8:3 9:7, 9 13:31, 23, Actes 4:27 13:1. 
__3. Herod Agrippa I: Actes 12:1, 6 12:11, 19 12:21 (cf. Ἀγρίππας (II)).†

G2264I.def:
Ἡρῴδης (Rec. -ώδης), -ου, ὁ 
Herod; 
__1. Herod the Great: Matthieu 2:1-23, Actes 23:35. 
__2. Herod Antipas (ὁ τετραάρχης, Matthieu 14:1): Matthieu 14:1, 3 14:6, Marc 6:1-56, Marc 8:15, Luc 1:5 3:1, 19 8:3 9:7, 9 13:31, 23, Actes 4:27 13:1. 
__3. Herod Agrippa I: Actes 12:1, 6 12:11, 19 12:21 (cf. Ἀγρίππας (II)).†

G2265.def:
Ἡρῳδιανοί (Rec. Ἡρω-), -ῶν, οἱ, 
Herodians, partisans of Herod (cf. τὸυς τὰ Ἡρῴδου φρονοῦνιτας, FlJ, Ant., xiv, 15, 10): Matthieu 22:16, Marc 3:6 12:13.†

G2266G.def:
Ἡρῳδιάς (Rec. Ἡρω-), -άδος, ἡ 
Herodias, granddaughter of Herod the Great: Matthieu 14:3, 6, Marc 6:17, 19 6:22, Luc 3:19.†

G2268.def:
Ἠσαίας (Rec. Ἠσαΐας), -ου, ο (Heb. יְשַׁעְיָה), 
Isaiah, the prophet: Matthieu 3:3 4:14 8:17 12:17 13:14, 35 15:7, Marc 7:6, Luc 3:4 4:17, Jean 1:23 12:38-39, 41, Actes 8:28 28:25, Romains 9:27, 29 10:16, 20 15:12; ἀνεγίνωςκεν τ. προφήτην Ἠ., Actes 8:30; ἐν τ. Ἠ., Marc 1:2.†

G2269G.def:
Ἠσαῦ, ὁ 
indecl. (Heb. עֵשָׂו, Genèse 25:25), 
Esau: Romains 9:13 (LXX) Hébreux 11:20 12:16.†

G2269H.def:
Ἠσαῦ, ὁ 
indecl. (Heb. עֵשָׂו, Genèse 25:25), 
Esau: Romains 9:13 (LXX) Hébreux 11:20 12:16.†

G2271.def:
ἡσυχία, -ας, ἡ
(ἡσύχιος, which see), [in LXX for אִישׁוֹן, שָׁלֵו, etc. ;] 
__1. quietness: 2 Thessaloniciens 3:12. 
__2. stillness, silence: Actes 22:2, 1 Timothée 2:11-12 †

G2272.def:
ἡσύχιος, -α, -ον
(= the more frequently ἥσυχος; cf. Wis.18:14, Sir.25:20), [in LXX: Ésaïe 66:2 (רוּחַ נָכֶה)* ;] 
quiet, tranquil: 1 Timothée 2:2, 1 Pierre 3:4.†
SYN.: ἤρεμος, of tranquillity arising from without; ἡ., from within (see Ellic. on 1Ti, l.with; but also see CGT, ib.).†

G2273.def:
1. = ἦ τοι, now surely, truly, verily , (Iliad by Homer); after ἀλλ᾽ εἰ . ., nevertheless , (Iliad by Homer) 
2. = ἤτοι, either in truth , followed by ἤ, or , (Herdotus Historicus), etc. (ML)

G2274.def:
ἡττάω, -ῶ
(ἡσσ-, 2 Corinthiens 12:13, see: ἥσσων) [in LXX for חָתַת, etc. ;] 
pass., 
__1. to be inferior: before ὑπέρ, 2 Corinthiens 12:13. 
__2. to be overcome: absol., 2 Pierre 2:20; with dative, 2 Pierre 2:19.†

G2275.def:
ἥττημα, -τος, τό 
[in LXX for מַס, Ésaïe 31:8 * ;] 
defect, loss, defeat: Romains 11:12 (cf. Isa, l.with), 1 Corinthiens 6:7 (cf. Field, Notes, 160 f., 171 f.; Lft., Notes, 212).†

G2276.def:
ἥσσων (Rec. ἥττ-, the Attic literary form), ἧσσων, 
inferior, less; neut., τὸ ἧ., adverbially, less: 2 Corinthiens 12:15; εἰς τὸ ἧ., for the worse (opposite to κρεῖττον): 1 Corinthiens 11:17.†

G2278.def:
ἠχέω, -ῶ
(ἦχος), [in LXX for הָמָה, etc. ;] 
to sound: 1 Corinthiens 13:1 (cf. ἐξ-, κατ-ηχέω).†

G2279.def:
ἦχος, -ου, ὁ
(also in late and MGr., -εος, τό, Luc 21:25), [in LXX for הָמוֹן, etc. ;] 
__1. a noise, sound: Actes 2:2; ἦ. θαλάσσης, Luc 21:25; σάλπιγγος, Hébreux 12:19 
__2. a report: before πεφί, Luc 4:37.†

G2280.def:
Θαδδαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Aram. תּדִאַי, תַּדַּי), 
Thaddæus: Matthieu 10:3, Marc 3:18 (WH, mg., Λεββαῖος, which see).†

G2281.def:
θάλασσα, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for יָם ;] 
the sea: Matthieu 23:15, Marc 11:23, Luc 21:25, Romains 9:27, Hébreux 11:12, Jacques 1:6, Ju 13, Apocalypse 7:1, al.; τὸ πέλαγος τῆς θ. (see Tr., ut infr.), Matthieu 18:6; ὁ οὐρανὸς κ. ἡ γῆ κ. ἡ θ., of the whole world, Actes 4:24, al. (Aggée 2:7); θ. ὑαλίνη, Apocalypse 4:6 15:2; of the Mediterranean, Actes 10:6, 32 17:14; of the Red Sea, ἐρυθρὰ θ., Actes 7:36, 1 Corinthiens 10:1-2, Hébreux 11:20; of an inland lake (as Heb. יָם), θ. τ. Γαλιλαίας, Matthieu 4:18 15:29, Marc 1:16 7:31; τ. Τιβεριάδος, Jean 21:1; τ. Γ. τ. T., Jean 6:1; of the same, simply ἡ θ., Matthieu 4:15, Marc 2:13, al 
SYN.: πέλαγος, the vast expanse of open water"; θ., "the sea as contrasted with the land" (Tr., Syn., xiii)

G2282.def:
θάλπω 
[in LXX for סָכַן, etc. ;] 
to heat, warm; metaphorically, 
__(a) to inflame (Trag.); 
__(b) to foster, cherish: Éphésiens 5:29, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:7.†

G2283.def:
Θάμαρ (Tr., Θαμάρ), ἡ (Heb. תָּמָר, Genèse 38:6), 
Tamar: Matthieu 1:3.†

G2284.def:
θαμβέω, -ῶ
(θάμβος) [in LXX for בָּעַת ni., pi., etc. ;] 
__1. to be amazed. 
__2. In late Gk., to astonish, terrify (2 Rois 22:5): pass., Marc 1:27 10:32; before ἐπί with dative of thing(s), Marc 10:24.†

G2285.def:
θάμβος, -ους, τό 
[in LXX for פַּחַד, etc. ;] 
amazement: Luc 4:36 5:9, Actes 3:10.†

G2287.def:
θανατη-φόρος, -ον
(θάνατος, φέρω), [in LXX: Nombres 18:22 (מוּת), Job 33:23, 4Ma.8:18 4Mac 8:26 4Mac 15:26 * ;] 
deadly, death-bringing: Jacques 3:8.†

G2288.def:
θάνατος, -ου, ὁ (θνήσκω), 
[in LXX chiefly for מָוֶת ,מוּת, sometimes דֶּבֶר ;] 
death; 
__1. of the death of the body, whether natural or violent: Jean 11:13, Philippiens 2:27, Hébreux 7:23, al; opposite to ζωή, Romains 8:38, Philippiens 1:20; of the death of Christ, Romains 5:10, Philippiens 3:10, Hébreux 2:9; ῥυέσθαι (σώζειν) ἐκ θ., 2 Corinthiens 1:10, Hébreux 5:7; περίλυπος ἕως θανάτου, Matthieu 26:38, Marc 14:34; μέχρι (ἄχρι), Philippiens 2:8, Apocalypse 2:10; πληγὴ θανάτου, a deadly wound. Apocalypse 13:3; ἰδεῖν θάνατον, Luc 2:26, Hébreux 11:5; γεύεσθαι θανάτου, Marc 9:1; ἔνοχος θανάτου, Marc 14:64; θανάτῳ τελευτᾶν ( Exode 21:17, מוּת יוּמָת), Marc 7:10; death personified, Romains 6:9, 1 Corinthiens 15:26, Apocalypse 21:4; pl., of deadly perils, 2 Corinthiens 11:23. 
__2. Of spiritual death: Jean 5:24 8:51, Romains 7:10, Jacques 1:15, 5:20, 1 Jean 3:14 5:16, al.; of eternal death, Romains 1:32 7:5, al.; ὁ θ. ὁ δεύτερος, Apocalypse 2:11 21:8 (cf. Cremer, 283ff.; DB, iii, 114ff.; DCG, i, 791f.).

G2289.def:
θανατόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for מוּת hi., ho., also for הָרַג, etc. ;] 
to put to death: with accusative, Matthieu 10:21 26:59 27:1, Marc 13:12 14:55, Luc 21:16, 2 Corinthiens 6:9, 1 Pierre 3:18; pass., Romains 8:36. Metaphorical: Romains 8:13; pass., with dative, (in relation to), Romains 7:4.†

G2290.def:
θάπτω 
[in LXX chiefly for קָבַר ;] 
to bury: with accusative, Matthieu 8:21-22 14:12, Luc 9:59-60, Actes 5:6, 9-10; pass., Luc 16:22, Actes 2:29, 1 Corinthiens 15:4.†

G2291.def:
Θαρά (Rec. Θάρα), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. תֶּרַח), 
Terah (Genèse 11:24-28, 31-32): Luc 3:34.†

G2292.def:
θαρρέω, -ῶ
(later form of θαρσέω), [in LXX: Proverbes 1:21, Bar.4:21, 27, from LXX Bar.6:16, (17), 4Ma.13:11 4Mac 17:4 * ;] 
to be of good cheer or courage, to be confident: 2 Corinthiens 5:6 5:8, Hébreux 13:6; τ. πεποιθήσει, 2 Corinthiens 10:2; before εἰς, 2 Corinthiens 10:1; ἐν, 2 Corinthiens 7:16.†
SYN.: τολμάω. "θ. has reference more to the character, τ. to its manifestation " (Thayer, see word τολμάω)

G2293.def:
θαρσέω, -ῶ
(see: θαρρέω), [in LXX chiefly for יָרֵא, with neg. ;] 
to be of good courage: imperat., θάραει, -εῖτε, Matthieu 9:2, 22 14:27, Marc 6:50 10:49, Jean 16:33, Actes 23:11.†

G2294.def:
1. courage, boldness , (Homer), attic; θ. τινός courage to do a thing, (Aeschulus Tragicus) 
2. that which gives courage , θάρση grounds of confidence , (Euripides) 
3. in bad sense, audacity , (Iliad by Homer): compare θράσος. (ML)

G2295.def:
θαῦμα, -τος, τό 
[in LXX: Job 17:8 18:20 20:8 21:5 (שַׂעַר, etc.)* ;] 
__1. a wonder: 2 Corinthiens 11:14. 
__2. wonder: Apocalypse 17:6.†

G2296.def:
θαυμάζω 
[in LXX for נָשָׂא, etc. ;] 
to marvel, wonder, wonder at: absol., Matthieu 8:10, 27 9:33 15:31 21:20 22:22 27:14, Marc 5:20 15:5, Luc 1:21 (R, txt.; ICC, in l, but see infr.), Luc 1:63 8:25 11:14 24:41, Jean 5:20 7:15, Actes 2:7 4:13 13:41, Apocalypse 17:7-8; with accusative of person(s), Luc 7:9; with accusative of thing(s), Luc 24:12 (WH, R, mg. om.), Jean 5:28, Actes 7:31; θαῦμα μέγα, Apocalypse 17:6; πρόσωπον (LXX for פָּנִים נָשָׂא, Deutéronome 10:17, al.), Ju 16; before διά, with accusative, Marc 6:6, Jean 7:21; before ἐν, with dative obj., Luc 1:21 (? R, mg., but see supr); before ἐπί, with dative of thing(s), Luc 2:33 4:22 9:43 20:26, Actes 3:12; περί, Luc 2:18; ὀπίσω, Apocalypse 13:3; ὅτι, Luc 11:38, Jean 3:7 4:27, Galates 1:6; εἰ, Marc 15:44, 1 Jean 3:13. Pass. (Sir.38:3, Wis.8:11): before ἐν, with dative of person(s), 2 Thessaloniciens 1:10 (cf. ἐκ-θαυμάζω).†

G2297.def:
θαυμάσιος, -α, -ον
(θαῦμα), [in LXX chiefly for פָּלָא ni. (n. pl. = פָּלָא Josué 3:5 ;) 
wonderful; n. pl., wonders: Matthieu 21:15.†

G2298.def:
θαυμαστός, -ή, -όν
(θαυμάζω), [in LXX for פָּלָא and cogn. forms (Psaumes 118:22-23 119:129, Ésaïe 25:1, al.), יָרֵא ni. (Exode 15:11, Psaumes 65:5, al.), אַדִּיר (Psaumes 8:1, 9 93:4), etc. ;] 
wonderful, marvellous: Matthieu 21:42 (LXX) Marc 12:11, Jean 9:30, 1 Pierre 2:9, Apocalypse 15:1, 3.†

G2299.def:
θεά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(fem. of θεός, which see), 
a goddess: Actes 19:27.†
